caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate wall-mounted box, likely made of metal, with intricate decorative patterns. The object is rendered in shades of black and gray, set against an off-white or beige background. The front surface of the box has diagonal bands and diamond shapes, incorporating symbols such as crosses, fleurs-de-lis, and other small motifs, all in low relief. The upper portion of the box features a flat lid with continued patterning, and an arched mounting plate with a central keyhole and some inscribed lettering, which appears to read "LETTERS" at the top and "PAT APRIL 2. 19" below. Four corners and the outer edges of the box include additional smaller decorative elements. The entire object is depicted in a three-quarters view, giving prominence to the side and front surfaces, and it is shaded realistically to indicate three-dimensionality. The lower left portion of the drawing bears the name “Julius Bellamy” in small, simple script.
title: Match Holder
